content:
I'm so sorry to hear that your Pearl Drop Earrings arrived damaged! 

Normally, damaged or incorrect items need to be reported within 48 hours of delivery. Since this order was delivered about 12 days ago, I'm unable to process a damaged-item claim directly here. 

However, I can pass this over to a colleague on our support team to see if they can take a closer look and help you out. Would you like me to connect you with them?
